fact: OTR's Lomé-port customs clearance manual (last modified 30 December 2020) states that online payment of the single fee document (DFU), which bundles customs duties, goes through the GUCE and posts to SYDONIA World, and that customs debts may be paid by electronic means (art. 103 CDN).
title: Manuel de procédures de dédouanement de la Direction des Opérations Douanières de Lomé-Port (DODLP)
